query: INSERT INTO ops.source_checkpoints(source_id,partition_key,cursor_payload,remote_high_watermark,last_success_at)          VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,clock_timestamp())          ON CONFLICT(source_id,partition_key) DO UPDATE SET cursor_payload=EXCLUDED.cursor_payload,            remote_high_watermark=EXCLUDED.remote_high_watermark,last_success_at=EXCLUDED.last_success_at,            version=ops.source_checkpoints.version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
